noPhone.title: No phone number needed
noPhone.body: You don't need a phone number or email. Just pick a name. gim gives you an Account ID.

onYourDevices.title: Your account lives on your devices
onYourDevices.body: Your account is kept on your devices, not on a server. Want to use it somewhere else? Link another device.

lockedMessages.title: Your messages are locked
lockedMessages.body: Messages are end-to-end encrypted. Only the people in the chat can read them. Not even the server can.

welcome.explanation: Chat with the people you care about. Start a new account, or use the one you already have.
welcome.link: Link to a device you already use

server.title: Choose your server
server.label: Server address
server.invalid: Enter a full address, like https://example.com
server.unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check the address and your internet connection.

link.qrExplanation: On a device where you use gim, open Settings > Account and devices, choose “Link a new device” and scan this code.
link.sasExplanation: Your other device shows a code too. Choose “The codes match” only if both are the same.
link.linked: This device is linked. Your chats appear after the first sync.
link.timedOut: No device answered in time. Show a new code to try again.
link.failed: Linking didn't work. Show a new code to try again.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.retryLater: The server is busy. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
